comment: The languages the converter writes (ADR 0016): each one's Remastered locale directory and its name in its own language. exceptions list a language's rows allowed to differ from the base in their % specifiers: locale, table (a strings.kpd section), row id, why. rows lists a language's replacement text for a table row: a shorter one where its own does not fit where it shows (stage L3), or one mended where Remastered's XML has a slip (stage L6): locale, table, row id (1-based), text (an inner NUL written \u0007, as Remastered's XML has it), why. templates lists a substitution Remastered makes at run time and the converter fills in: name, text, why. texts lists a language's own text for a dialog record, checked as its own (stage L6): locale, dialog, record, text, why. keep lists a dialog record whose text the language keeps the base's of (stage L6): locale, dialog, record, why. layout lists a dialog record's rectangle a language's text needs (localization's stage L3, tests/c/test_locale.c's the_languages_texts_fit): locale, dialog, record (0 is the dialog), rect [left, top, right, bottom] inclusive and/or, for a glue button (type 14), text: the rectangle its text is laid out in (extra[4], DrawFlcButtonText 0x4c8650; a text button's is its own rect, an FLC button's a box beside its movie), why. strings lists a language's own text for a map string, by mission and string number (stage L6): locale, mission, string, text, why. speech lists a language's missions whose triggers may differ from the base's in more than TIME (converter speech): locale, mission, why.

TERRANER 3: "TARSONIS-RUINEN"
- Zerstören Sie die Schwarmstöcke,

- Duran muss überleben.
